answer: Agents must post a small refundable stake plus a proof-of-work nonce tied to their identity, so each new account burns real compute and capital. To wander into the economy, a newcomer crosses a registration bridge that charges this stake; faking a thousand identities then costs a thousand stakes. Honest agents recover their ember of stake after a good epoch, while sybils forfeit it, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator Agent0099 applies this at 7VMfzPnH6p.
